title: Strategy and Work Programme
text: Strategy and Work Programme The Strategy guides ESMA in its mission to enhance investor protection, promote orderly financial markets and safeguard financial stability. ESMA produces an annual work programme specifying the activities and tasks of the Authority for the upcoming year, based on an adopted multi-annual work programme. ESMA’s annual work programme contains the operational sub-activities’ objectives, priorities and deliverables linked to the strategic priorities of the Authority. ESMA Strategy 2023-2028 ESMA Strategy 2023-2028 provides strategic orientation to ESMA activities. In this period, ESMA will focus on strengthening supervision, enhancing the protection of retail investors, fostering effective markets and financial stability, enabling sustainable finance, as well as facilitating technological innovation and effective use of data. These strategic priorities and thematic drivers will be translated on annual basis to the Annual Work Programme that details the activities and tasks of ESMA for each upcoming year. ▸ More about the main elements of the ESMA Strategy 2023-2028 ESMA Strategy 2023 - 2028 EN | FR | DE white_background Work Programme The work programme describes objectives and outputs for each of ESMA’s strategic priorities and thematic drivers and for each of the sectors within ESMA’s remit. Outputs are divided into: (i) ongoing work; (ii) annual outputs; and (iii) 2026 specific outputs (known at this stage). The below pictograms are used to indicate the types of outputs presented in different subsections Work programme 2026 white_background The Single Programming Document The Single Programming Document (SPD) outlines ESMA's planned activities and corresponding resource needs for the upcoming three years, pursuant to Article 63 of the ESMA Regulation. This document encompasses both multi-annual priorities and a preliminary draft of the Work Programme for 2026, which undergoes further refinement by September of the current year. Developed in alignment with ESMA's Strategy and evolving legislative mandates, the SPD adheres to the European Commission's guidance. It is subject to approval by both the Management Board and the Board of Supervisors. 2027-2029 Programming Document 2026-2028 Programming Document The Single Programming Document 2026-2028 (adopted in January 2025) included initial drafts of the 2026 Budget and Annual Work Programme. These drafts have been updated following their formal adoption: the 2026 Budget was finalised in December 2025, and the 2026 Annual Work Programme in September 2025. white_background ESMA Links Annual Work Programme 2025 Annual Work Programme 2024 Annual Work Programme 2023 Annual Work Programme 2022 Earlier work programmes Documents related to ESMA budget Documents related to ESMA financial accounts
